lessons.title: One authoritative source per fact
lessons.summary: Keep rules, current state, and durable lessons separate. Tool entry points should reference shared content instead of maintaining drifting copies.
lessons.evidence: Prior engineering incidents, generalized and scope-reviewed 2026-10-15. See IMPORT_REVIEW.md. This is not target-project runtime verification.

lessons.title: Match status claims to current evidence
lessons.summary: Implementation, testing, deployment, enablement, and real use need separate evidence. Resolve conflicts between memory and current observations.
lessons.evidence: Prior engineering incidents, generalized and scope-reviewed 2026-10-15. See IMPORT_REVIEW.md. This is not target-project runtime verification.

lessons.title: Distinguish errors from empty results
lessons.summary: Do not turn read failures into empty values, default content, or success. Fallback behavior must be explicit and observable.
lessons.evidence: Prior engineering incidents, generalized and scope-reviewed 2026-10-15. See IMPORT_REVIEW.md. This is not target-project runtime verification.

lessons.title: Isolate the actual test resources
lessons.summary: Before local commands run, verify resolved databases, accounts, storage, and SDK configuration. Tests must not inherit production side effects.
lessons.evidence: Prior engineering incidents, generalized and scope-reviewed 2026-10-15. See IMPORT_REVIEW.md. This is not target-project runtime verification.

lessons.title: Separate task ownership from shared-resource coordination
lessons.summary: Preserve unrelated edits and stage exact task-owned paths. Isolate concurrent editing, and coordinate shared refs and deployment targets separately.
lessons.evidence: Prior engineering incidents, generalized and scope-reviewed 2026-10-15. See IMPORT_REVIEW.md. This is not target-project runtime verification.

lessons.title: Verification must preserve failure
lessons.summary: A failed or timed-out required check, missing executable, or missing configuration must never become PASS.
lessons.evidence: Prior engineering incidents, generalized and scope-reviewed 2026-10-15. See IMPORT_REVIEW.md. This is not target-project runtime verification.

lessons.title: Verify the actual execution path at the right depth
lessons.summary: Static checks and mocks establish only their own layer. External dependencies, actual configuration, and user interactions need appropriate runtime evidence.
lessons.evidence: Prior engineering incidents, generalized and scope-reviewed 2026-10-15. See IMPORT_REVIEW.md. This is not target-project runtime verification.

lessons.title: A configuration name is not a deployment identity
lessons.summary: Verify the actual account, project, environment, candidate revision, and serving endpoint. Neither a filename nor a passing build proves deployment.
lessons.evidence: Prior engineering incidents, generalized and scope-reviewed 2026-10-15. See IMPORT_REVIEW.md. This is not target-project runtime verification.

lessons.title: Find authoritative data and preserve drafts
lessons.summary: Before content repair, identify the real data authority, preserve drafts and operational edits, and migrate by field and version.
lessons.evidence: Prior engineering incidents, generalized and scope-reviewed 2026-10-15. See IMPORT_REVIEW.md. This is not target-project runtime verification.

lessons.title: Verify durable writes, not just successful responses
lessons.summary: Verify critical writes from a separate connection or transaction. Exercise concurrency, failure, and rollback instead of trusting returned objects.
lessons.evidence: Prior engineering incidents, generalized and scope-reviewed 2026-10-15. See IMPORT_REVIEW.md. This is not target-project runtime verification.

lessons.title: Fix access rules without default privilege escalation
lessons.summary: Keep intended role and tenant boundaries. Shared capabilities and tenant-specific parameters need separate ownership.
lessons.evidence: Prior engineering incidents, generalized and scope-reviewed 2026-10-15. See IMPORT_REVIEW.md. This is not target-project runtime verification.

lessons.title: Test controls and destinations in the rendered product
lessons.summary: Use real control semantics and behavior. Check final destinations and the relevant keyboard, pointer, and touch interactions.
lessons.evidence: Prior engineering incidents, generalized and scope-reviewed 2026-10-15. See IMPORT_REVIEW.md. This is not target-project runtime verification.

lessons.title: Give technical lessons version scope and removal conditions
lessons.summary: Preserve the failure mechanism while rechecking version-specific commands and workarounds. Historical experience is not permanent truth.
lessons.evidence: Prior engineering incidents, generalized and scope-reviewed 2026-10-15. See IMPORT_REVIEW.md. This is not target-project runtime verification.

lessons.title: Protect invariants during bulk edits
lessons.summary: Check numerical, structural, and behavioral invariants. Diagnose unexpected differences and ownership before restoring files.
lessons.evidence: Prior engineering incidents, generalized and scope-reviewed 2026-10-15. See IMPORT_REVIEW.md. This is not target-project runtime verification.

lessons.title: Control time and business time zones in tests
lessons.summary: Use explicit clocks and business time zones. Cover midnight and daylight-saving boundaries instead of waiting or skipping flaky tests.
lessons.evidence: Prior engineering incidents, generalized and scope-reviewed 2026-10-15. See IMPORT_REVIEW.md. This is not target-project runtime verification.

lessons.title: Treat caches and background processes as build inputs
lessons.summary: Isolate task-owned caches, outputs, and watchers. Investigate environment contamination before deleting shared resources.
